dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: I did not expect the Arataki Gang to defeat so many mighty beetle fighters. It seems that you are well-versed in this art.

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: I take back what I once said. You are respectable and worthy opponents, and I must face you as such — with my full strength!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty! Bull-Chucker, you're our leader. It's your time to shine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And, uh, don't take what was said earlier seriously!

choices.text: You're up, Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahahahahaha! Oh, it's on! The final showdown, and my soon-to-be final victory!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I don't know how you've been leading your crew, but the results speak for themselves: The Arataki Gang rules!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Grandmaster Hanakado, get ready to battle!

choices.text: The King versus the Grandmaster! This will be legendary!

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: I see. I see... Let us battle once more. This time, I'll see through all of your methods.

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: Victory and defeat no longer seem so important... Let's just battle for fun, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: It's rare that I should find such a great opponent. It would be a shame to end our battles so soon, would it not?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But seeing through my secret beetle-fighting techniques? Nah, little fella, that ain't gonna happen!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: If you'll admit that I'm the stronger beetle fighter, I'll fight you for as many rounds as you want!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like Bull-Chucker and Grandmaster Hanakado are still raring to go... Well, let's leave them to it! They can battle beetles till the beetle-battling's done!
